title: Furnace Dies
kidsText: The heater broke in winter. You have to pay to fix it today.
adultText: In January. The repair company can come tomorrow if you pay today.

title: Car Repair
kidsText: Your car broke down. You need it for work, so you pay now.
adultText: Transmission trouble. You need the car to get to work, so there is no putting it off.

title: Job Loss
kidsText: You lost your job. Bills still come. You skip your next turn.
adultText: Layoffs. You find new work, but a month of bills comes due before the first paycheck. Skip your next turn.

title: Emergency Room Visit
kidsText: You got hurt and went to the hospital. The bill comes today.
adultText: A fall on the ice, an X-ray, and a few stitches. Your share of the bill after insurance is due now.

title: Roof Leak
kidsText: Rain is coming through the roof. It has to be fixed now.
adultText: Water stains on the ceiling after a storm. The roofer can patch it this week if you pay up front.

title: Cracked Tooth
kidsText: Your tooth cracked and hurts. The dentist fixes it today.
adultText: A crown and a root canal. Dental insurance covers part of it, and the rest is due at the visit.

title: Water Heater Bursts
kidsText: The hot water tank broke and flooded the floor. You pay to fix it.
adultText: A puddle in the basement and no hot water. A new water heater plus installation, today.

title: Vet Emergency
kidsText: Your dog ate something bad. The animal doctor helps, and you pay.
adultText: The dog swallowed a sock. Surgery, an overnight stay, and a cone of shame. The clinic wants payment at pickup.

title: Broken Wrist
kidsText: You broke your wrist and cannot work for a while. Skip your next turn.
adultText: A cast for six weeks and no work for one month. Short-term disability covers part, not all. Skip your next turn.

title: Family Needs Help
kidsText: Your brother cannot pay his rent this month. You help him.
adultText: Your brother's hours were cut and rent is due. Family comes first, and savings make it possible to help.
